snippet.title: Road to Hollow Hills Trailer #3
snippet.description:
Step into the haunting world of Road to Hollow Hills in our latest trailer. 

In this trailer, we showcase a selection of the game’s demo levels, giving players a glimpse of the locations they’ll explore in search of answers. Follow John as he treads through twisted paths in the heart of the forest, encounters unsettling remnants of those who came before, and unearths clues that piece together the story of Hollow Hills.

Ride to survive, fight to win... Road to Hollow Hills

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1345270/Road_to_Hollow_Hills/
